rule: All required phases need actual evidence; no runtime/Docker PASS is asserted by this document.

requirements.statement: Host tooling never substitutes container tooling or blocks a valid declared container merely by being absent.
Resolve exact Docker context, Compose project/files/profiles/service/replica and approved workspace before probes.
Build/test/runtime targets have distinct toolchains and traceable artifact provenance; runtime without compiler can be valid.
Evidence and reusable receipts include image/source/locks/config/target/platform/user/mount/tool identities; tags and image digest alone are insufficient.
Static config/running state/version output do not replace actual commands, dependency readiness or required GPU proof in the runner.
Exec and one-off validation preserve isolation, authorization, non-secret evidence and run-owned cleanup; no implicit host SDK/socket privilege or global cleanup.
Warm verification avoids redundant installs/builds and any remote LLM while keeping current identity/readiness checks and measured latency.
Validation scope and executor location are independent: a Docker runner does not authorize host/live effects or an arbitrary workspace.

taskObligations.T00: Inventory actual Docker contexts/services/build/test/runtime targets and compare host-only vs container probes; no mutation.
taskObligations.T01: Schema DockerRunnerRef/ToolchainEvidence, orthogonal validationScope and required evidence phases.
taskObligations.T03: Resolve descriptor/adapter service/target/overlays and capability needs, not installed host SDKs.
taskObligations.T04: Dispatch approved probes and tests in the resolved container; fail-closed on mismatch without host fallback.
taskObligations.T08: Bind execution receipts to actual runner and guard scope/workspace; preserve worker/finalizer parity.
taskObligations.T10: Reuse hermetic receipts only with complete runner inputs; current readiness remains live.
taskObligations.T11: Build/test targets, immutable image/artifact linkage, mounts/resource leases and isolated one-off lifecycle.
taskObligations.T12: Real Docker/DB/queue/worker proofs, not only config or provider fixtures.
taskObligations.T13: Docker-first doctor/preflight/CLI; host probes only for explicitly required controller tools.
taskObligations.T15: Negative matrix DTC-01-DTC-08 with behavior tests, not source-regex-only.
taskObligations.T16: Measure warm/cold toolchain verification independently from product tests and model time.
taskObligations.T21: Keep current runtime-services/caches/memory; report tooling proof separately from cached context.
taskObligations.C00: Reconcile local Compose/engineering env/service mapping without overriding local pin.
taskObligations.C01: Consumer wrapper carries approved Docker runner identity/proof, no host compiler fallback.
taskObligations.C02: Declare real service/test target mappings and run consumer tests inside corresponding containers.
taskObligations.C03: Promote only with required container evidence; preserve existing resources and data.

ownership: Existing task writePaths only; new paths require explicit Technical Refinement revision.
